description: An interpolation in a quoted template can contain a heredoc
notes: The spec describes a quoted template as a single-line expression, but an interpolation may contain a heredoc, which always spans lines. That wording is the only conflict, since the newline after the heredoc's closing marker belongs to what contains the heredoc. hashicorp/hcl accepts it: its scanner (hclsyntax/scan_tokens.rl) reads the heredoc inside the interpolation, and parseTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go ignores the newline after it.
